title: feat(search): add backtracking fuzzy search to plugin-search
body:
## Summary
- Add backtracking DP fuzzy search to `@floatboat/nexus-plugin-search` with score-ranked overlap deduplication.
- Wire a Fuzzy toggle into the search panel (mutually exclusive with regexp / whole-word) and route find/replace/select through fuzzy-aware navigation.
- Export `findFuzzyMatches` / `findBestFuzzySpanFromStart` helpers and mark roadmap item #17 done.

## Why
Nexus roadmap P2 called for a fuzzy matcher with backtracking rather than literal-only search. This keeps Markdown as the source of truth while letting power users jump to subsequence matches (e.g. `fc` → `func`) inside the existing CodeMirror search UI.

## Test plan
- [x] `pnpm test packages/plugin-search` (45 tests)
- [x] `pnpm test` (531 tests)
- [x] `pnpm --filter @floatboat/nexus-plugin-search build`

commits_at_first_review.message:
feat(search): add backtracking fuzzy search to plugin-search

Implement DP-based subsequence matching with score-ranked deduplication,
search panel toggle, and navigation helpers so users can find non-literal
matches without leaving the existing CodeMirror search UI.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
